comment: Wizard-mode Valkyrie on the Castle level. A wand of cold bridges the raised drawbridge's moat span with ice (DRAWBRIDGE_UP over DB_ICE). The hero writes Elbereth in the frost on the span, steps off and back on: read_engr_at() reads is_ice() and says the text is written in the frost. The cold-resistant Valkyrie also takes slippery_ice_fumbling()'s no-slip arm.
